commands_used: answer 1. I serve the Toh-Reel-Ka as a Voh-Vastei. Hist trees are sickening, the Unbound drain sap, and the Eye of Argonia, a Hist-amber jewel at the Root, could heal the trees. 2. Go to Gideon market and find the dealer selling the Eye of Argonia. The marker points at Ovinius Calo, who is here. 3. I can talk to Ovinius Calo and persuade him or pay a few coins. I can also look at the Glass Eye thing here. Quiet is favoured. 4. I do not know who Ovinius Calo is. The item is labelled Glass, so it may be a fake. I can find out by talking to him and examining it.

answer 1. The Eye for sale is cheap glass, not the real Eye. Ovinius bought it from smugglers who kept the old silver setting, which may hold a clue. Two Unbound and a man called the Collector also asked about it. 2. Go to Gideon South Watch, the leaning tower south-east of the quay, and take the silver setting from the smugglers locked chest in the inner room. 3. Fight the smugglers, or sneak past them and pick the lock, or take the key from the boss. Quiet is favoured, so I will sneak and pick the lock. 4. I do not know who the Collector is beyond being an Imperial relic-hunter. I do not know why the setting matters. I may find out at the tower.

answer 1. I lifted the boss key and took the Old Silver Setting from the chest unseen. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, a relic-hunter, had opened it first and left a note saying a ship name is scratched inside the band. 2. Bring the setting to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom, by rootworm from Gideon Hist garden. 3. Go straight back to her, or first read the note and look at the band for the ship name. I have not yet taken the note. 4. I do not know which ship it is or why it matters, nor how the Collector fits in. Nesh-Deeka may know.

answer 1. The Gideon Eye was glass. The setting is scratched with the name Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight, south of Thorn on the east coast, with a Gideon dealer stock aboard. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold. The Unbound were also asking after the glass. 2. Nothing is set yet; the wreck at Hatandros Bight looks like the next lead, but she has not told me to go. 3. Ask Nesh-Deeka more, or go toward Hatandros Bight. 4. I do not know how the wreck links to the real Eye, or how she knows what the Unbound do beyond we listen.

answer I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka, serving Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The Eye of Argonia on sale in Gideon was glass (a cheap garnet). I lifted the key from the smuggler boss at Gideon South Watch and took the Old Silver Setting from the chest, plus the Collector note. The Collector is Ennodius Vanin, an Imperial relic-hunter who has chased the Eye for twenty years. Inside the band is scratched Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight, east coast south of Thorn, with a Gideon dealer stock aboard. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold and returned the setting, and I carry it with the note. Two Unbound asked after the glass a month ago. I have no lockpicks. The next lead is probably the wreck at Hatandros Bight, but she has not ordered it. I still need to learn how the wreck ties to the real Eye.
